Spell Name Generator

Conjure fantasy spell names tagged with their school of magic — evocation, illusion, necromancy, and more.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a school (or all).
  2. Press Conjure Spells.
  3. Click any spell to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which schools of magic are included?

Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, Abjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Conjuration, and Transmutation.

Do spells show their school?

Every spell shows its school, so you can sort your spellbook properly.

How many per click?

8 spells per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy one?

Click any spell to copy its name and school.
